# Leftovers audit 1023 (auditor `leftovers-b`, wave 1023b)

Read-only audit of what this fleet ticket must clean up before `ticket_close`. Input for the coordinator. Nothing was edited or deleted except this file. Scan time: 2026-10-23, about 02:10 to 02:25 local. Own processes stopped: a `du` (pid 5089) and a `git log -S` (pid 11613), both started by this audit.

Snapshot: the `rg` scan ran about 02:10 and the diff about 02:12; peers keep editing, so re-run the scan before close.

Checked: `rg` over the repo (excluding `.🧬semio/**`, `node_modules`, `target`, `dist`), `git diff HEAD` (33 changed files in the working tree), `hdiutil info`, `du -skx` on `.cache/b/*`, `git hash-object` of the staged dirs against `git ls-files -s`. Full raw data: Appendix D (all 1097 lines).

## Summary: what must go before close

1. **Spin-hunt instrumentation and one undocumented debug line must be removed.** In `🏃️process/🧭️routing/📥️invocation/🏃️process/🟦️.ts`: the spin-hunt block (markers at lines 16 and 18 are committed at HEAD; line 17 is changed and uncommitted) and the `__spinTrack` hook at line 194 (uncommitted). Also `[DEBUG] inspect receiver` in `🏃️process/📦️artifacts/🏗️native-build/💾️storage/🧹️cleanup/🎛️command/🟦️.ts:135` (uncommitted, not in any result file). All are gated by `SEMIO_DEBUG_SPIN=1`. Uncommitted `[DEBUG]` lines in the working tree: exactly 3 (135, 17, 194).
2. **Staged source copies: 176 `staged*` dirs (143 top-most), 4977 files, 140.9 MiB.** 4791 of the 4977 files (96 %) are byte-identical to tracked blobs. AGENTS.md forbids this. Close-prep-1022 counted 167 dirs; the count is now 176.
3. **Attached disk images: 9 repo images are still mounted** (7 under `.cache/b/*`, 1 nested `.cache/b/n/m/<hash>/native`, 1 under `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/⚡️cache/rust/fixed`). All mount points exist, none is under this ticket, all holder processes are alive. The 2 Apple simulator runtime DMGs are system images, leave them.
4. **Disk footprint:** `🗑️generated` is 5.70 GiB (`deps4-sync*.log` alone 1.11 GiB). `.cache/b/*` allocates about 49.6 GiB (`p` 24 GiB, `d` 8, `t` 8, `g` 6, `o` 2, `n` 1.5, `l` 0.06).
5. **Dag-host Cargo.toml temporary line: already gone.** Resolved, see section 6.
6. **Committed `[DEBUG]` lines in non-test source that are ungated or undocumented** (decide, do not silently keep): `script.ts:21`, `…/cleanup/♻️retirement/📋️contract/🟦️.ts:65`, `…/router-effect-handler-and-jobs/🦀️.rs:379`, `…/build/🕸️graph/🟦️.ts:503` (gated by `SEMIO_BUILD_TRACE_AUTHORITY`, a peer's line). Details in section 1.
